Sam (AE): FYI - NorthStar Health is pausing PO until we provide ISO 27001 scope excerpt, SOC2 cover page, and a signed pen-test confirmation. They also want an isolated staging tenant for a 48h external scan and confirmation on whether we can rotate keys for authenticated scans.
Harper (SE): We can provision an isolated tenant. Need CIDRs for their scanner and an expected QPS profile. If they push >200 rps sustained we'll need a reserved burst which affects pricing.
Maya (Security): We have a standard pen-test confirmation template. Legal approves signer. For key rotation: we can issue a short-lived service principal (24-72h TTL) for authenticated scans and enable log streaming. If they insist on long-term KMS control, that's a Private deployment ask.
Sam (AE): Procurement wants the attestation signed and the environment confirmed by COB Monday. They're sensitive about remediation proof for critical findings in the last year. Can we provide a summary?
Maya (Security): Yes 5 we can provide a remediation summary table (date, summary, severity, ticket ref). No raw ticket exports or internal PII. We'll redact customer-specific identifiers.
Harper (SE): Also recommend we provide a presigned test dataset instead of a production snapshot. Example workflow:
```bash
# presign workflow - 15m expiry
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-testing/northstar-scan.tar.gz --expires-in 900
# apply bucket policy to allow GET only from provided CIDRs
```
Sam (AE): They asked if we can sign a short SOW limiting liability for the scan window. Jon, can Legal draft a one-page SOW/NDA addendum?
Jon (Legal): Yep, I can draft SOW with indemnity and allowed vectors. If they require CISO-level signature we'll need exec approval. I'll post a draft by EOD.
ticket-bot: Created ticket SLS-9921: "NorthStar POC evidence + scan coordination" assigned to Maya (Security). Priority: high.
Maya (Security): I'll attach SOC2 cover page + ISO scope excerpt and a draft attestation template in the ticket. Sam, ask the customer for tester name, insurance cert, and their scan rules.
Harper (SE): Ballpark cost impact: +8-15% on Dedicated quote depending on expected peak and ops standby. I can firm numbers once they share qps and CIDRs.
Sam (AE): Action items: Maya -> upload artifacts & attestation; Jon -> draft SOW; Harper -> cost delta + runbook; I'll chase NorthStar for CIDRs, tester name, and insurance.
Sam (AE): Thanks team. I'll update procurement and ask customer to confirm scope. :thumbsup:
